courses.title: Rest Ritual
courses.description: The studio's own evening class in Kuala Lumpur, held on Tuesday and Thursday nights, for winding down after the working day. A gentle stretch for the neck, shoulders, back and hips is followed by guided breathwork and a closing sound bath; it is open to every level and can also be joined live online.

left_out: Wellness Zone (red light therapy, infrared sauna, cold plunge, https://www.mysoreroom.com/wellness-zone): claims to balance hormones in menopause and thyroid conditions and to aid weight loss; treatment claims, and not spiritual practice. Still out.
flags: Rest Ritual is described on the class-types page (which covers all the studio's classes; no other item on the listing uses that URL). The page frames it on healthy sleep and mental health in the city; allowed wellbeing wording. Price: the class is booked with the studio's passes and memberships (drop in MYR 108 on https://www.mysoreroom.com/schedule-prices-1), so 'Contact for pricing' is used here.
